_note: Scripts for the caller teleprompter (Phone A) and the no-second-phone simulation. Written by us for the demo; not used in training.

scripts.title: Digital arrest (scam)
lines: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Ramesh? This is Inspector Vikram Rathore from Mumbai Cyber Crime cell.
A parcel booked with your Aadhaar number was seized at Mumbai airport. It had five fake passports and drugs.
A case has been registered against you for money laundering, and an arrest warrant is issued in your name.
This is a confidential investigation. Do not tell anyone in your family about this call.
Stay on the line. If you disconnect, the local police will come to arrest you within two hours.
To prove you are innocent, you must transfer your savings to the RBI verification account. It will be refunded after the investigation.
Open your banking app now and send fifty thousand rupees to the account I give you. Do it immediately.

scripts.title: Bank KYC + OTP (scam)
lines: Hello sir, I am calling from SBI head office, KYC department.
Your KYC has expired. If it is not updated today, your account will be blocked.
I have sent a verification code to your mobile. Please read the OTP to me so I can update your KYC.
Sir, quickly, the system will block the account in ten minutes.
Also install AnyDesk from the Play Store so our technician can complete it from our side.

scripts.title: Polite refund (scam, no threats)
lines: Good evening madam, I am calling from Flipkart customer care regarding your last order.
You were charged twice, so we would like to refund the extra amount to you.
For the refund, please download the app called AnyDesk, it is our support tool.
Now open it and tell me the nine digit number on the screen, and accept the request.

scripts.title: Delivery OTP (genuine)
lines: Hello, I am the Delhivery delivery person, I have reached your apartment gate.
Your parcel from Amazon is here. Please tell me the delivery OTP that came on your phone.
It is prepaid, no payment is needed.
Okay, I am coming up to the third floor now. Thank you.

scripts.title: Real bank fraud alert (genuine)
lines: Hello, this is the fraud monitoring team from HDFC Bank.
Did you just make a transaction of eighteen thousand rupees at a jewellery store in Delhi?
We have temporarily blocked the card for your safety. A new card will be sent to your address.
Please do not share any OTP or PIN with anyone. The bank never asks for it.

scripts.title: Clinic reminder (genuine)
lines: Hello, this is Apollo clinic, calling to confirm your appointment.
Your appointment with Dr. Meena is tomorrow at 10 am. Please come fifteen minutes early.
Please bring your old reports and the prescription.
Okay, see you tomorrow. Thank you.
